clips.title: The story
paras: Maurin Bonesplitter has found the demon lord far more dangerous than expected. He is certain Takata Steelblade doubts his abilities, and leaving the swordsman uninformed of what happened would insult Takata's honor. Maurin sends you to speak with Takata, who is nearby.

Maurin Bonesplitter finds the creature much more dangerous than he had anticipated. No doubt Takata Steelblade questions whether Maurin can handle it, and not being told of what just happened would insult Takata's honor. Maurin asks you to speak to the swordsman and offer to slay the demon, should Takata allow it. Maurin cautions you not to press Takata too hard, since it is better if Takata believes the idea is his own.
Takata Steelblade is close at hand, just across the path from Maurin, on a cliff overlooking the Kodo Graveyard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated. No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.
Speak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. It is better if he thinks it his own idea.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I witnessed what just occurred with Maurin and the demon lord. That creature, even as an apparition, seems to have more power than my warlock companion. I wonder if he's up to the task of defeating the monster? It would serve the Warchief better if I go myself, but with my responsibilities here, I would disgrace my clan if I turned my back on my duties here to battle this evil for my own honor.
